title: epan: Zlib: Remove unnecessary memcpy and memset
description:
Zlib inflate already memsets the output buffer, there's no reason to do
that or allocate it with malloc0. We don't need to memcpy the output
buffer repeatedly; decompress in-place and realloc it as needed.

Tested with the decompression bombs in #13779 and #21097, also with the
zero length compressed file in #6480. It reduces the amount of
instructions according to callgrind by some 25-33%, though the first
file is still slow for other reasons (application/x-www-form-urlencoded
is slow.)

AI-Assisted: no
